prompt: reply.removeHeader(name) only removes the header from Fastify's own header store. A header set directly on the Node response (reply.raw.setHeader('X-Foo', 'raw')) is still visible through reply.getHeader/getHeaders/hasHeader after removeHeader, and is still sent to the client. Fix reply.removeHeader so that, matching the name case-insensitively, it also removes the header from the underlying response, whether the header was set only on reply.raw or on both reply.raw and through reply.header(). After removal, getHeader returns undefined, getHeaders() has no such key, hasHeader is false and the client receives no such header. removeHeader keeps returning the reply, and must not throw when the headers have already been sent (for example after reply.hijack() and reply.raw.flushHeaders()); in that case the header already sent stays as it was.
requirement: Reply.prototype.removeHeader(key) lowercases key, deletes it from kReplyHeaders and, if reply.raw.headersSent is false, also calls reply.raw.removeHeader(key); it returns the reply. Raw-only and layered headers are both removed from getHeader/getHeaders/hasHeader and from the response sent. After the headers are sent it does not throw and the sent header is unaffected.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a header set only with reply.raw.setHeader('X-Foo', 'raw') and removed with removeHeader('x-FoO') is gone from getHeader, getHeaders and hasHeader, and the client receives no x-foo header
a header set on reply.raw and then with reply.header('x-foo', 'fastify') is fully removed by removeHeader('x-foo')
removeHeader returns the reply; after reply.hijack() and reply.raw.flushHeaders() it does not throw and the client still receives the raw header

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.11.3 (removeHeader leaves raw response headers), fixed upstream in b9e54023 (#6860/#6939). The reference is that fix applied to v5.11.3; the hidden suite is the upstream tests (loopback server and fetch).
